signals.text: Bellingham agrees new Real deal - Saturday's gossip. Real Madrid midfielder Jude Bellingham ready to commit his future to La Liga club, Arsenal and Liverpool told price for Brentford's Kevin Schade, Man Utd and Chelsea among clubs monitoring Jules Kounde's future at Barcelona, plus more.
Chelsea's James out for three months after knee surgery. Chelsea captain Reece James is set to miss three months of action after undergoing knee surgery.
